23 September 2026
B&M European Value Retail plc
Appointment of Non-Executive Director

B&M European Value Retail plc (the 'Company'), the UK's leading variety goods value retailer, is pleased to announce the appointment of Mike Iddon as an independent Non-Executive Director of the Company, with effect from 4th January 2027.
Mike will also become a member of the Audit and Risk Committee and the Nomination Committee with effect from his appointment.

Mike is an experienced retail finance leader with an extensive career across large-scale, multi-site consumer businesses. He was most recently the Group Chief Financial Officer of Pets at Home Group plc. Before that, he was Chief Financial Officer of New Look and held a number of senior finance leadership roles during a 13-year career at Tesco plc, including Chief Financial Officer of Tesco UK and Chief Financial Officer of Tesco South Korea. Earlier in his career, Mike held finance roles at Kingfisher and Whitbread and trained with Arthur Andersen.

Mike has been a Non-Executive Director of Wickes Group plc since 2021 and chairs its Audit and Risk Committee. He is a chartered accountant and a member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales.
Tiffany Hall, Chair, commented:

"I am delighted to welcome Mike to the Board. He brings deep financial, commercial and listed-company experience, together with an extensive understanding of large-scale retail businesses. His perspective will strengthen the Board as we continue to execute our strategy and focus on delivering sustainable long-term value for shareholders."
Mike Iddon commented:

"I am very pleased to be joining the Board of B&M. The Group has a strong value proposition and an important role in serving customers across the UK and France. I look forward to working with Tiffany, Tjeerd and the wider Board as the business continues to deliver its strategy."
This announcement is made pursuant to UK Listing Rule 6.4.6R. The Company confirms that there is no additional information to be disclosed pursuant to UK Listing Rule 6.4.8R.

About B&M European Value Retail plc

B&M European Value Retail plc is a variety retailer with 797 stores in the UK operating under the 'B&M' brand, 339 stores under the 'Heron Foods' and 'B&M Express' brands, and 155 stores in France also operating under the 'B&M' brand as at 9 September 2026.
The B&M Group was founded in 1978 and listed on the London Stock Exchange in June 2014. For more information, please visit www.bandmretail.com.
